definitions.coverage: fraction of the frame's static pixels covered by the rendered backdrop
definitions.depth_med_mm: median |z_render - z_video| over static covered pixels (mm), per frame
definitions.depth_bias_mm: signed median (z_render - z_video): negative = backdrop in front of the video surface
definitions.front_violation: fraction of static covered pixels where the backdrop is >5 mm in front of the video depth
definitions.gb_violation: fraction of visible gallbladder pixels where the backdrop is >2 mm in front of the gallbladder
definitions.gb_gap_mm: median depth gap (mm) between the backdrop and the visible gallbladder front surface (room for the gallbladder body)
definitions.photo_l1: mean |rgb_render - rgb_video| (0-255) over static covered non-specular pixels
definitions.photo_ncc: global NCC of grey render vs grey video over the same pixels
definitions.photo_lncc: mean 15x15 windowed NCC over the same pixels (texture alignment)
definitions.frame_iou: silhouette IoU of the backdrop with the whole frame minus instruments (the backdrop should be behind everything)
definitions.liver_iou: IoU of the visible liver-labelled backdrop part with the SAM liver mask (gallbladder/strand/instrument pixels ignored)
definitions.liver_bf: boundary F (4 px) of the same
definitions.spread: multi-view consistency: 1.4826*MAD across frames of the fused reference depth per observed cell (mm)
definitions.warp_consistency: static pixels of frame k lifted with a depth (fused backdrop rendered into k, or frame k's own depth map), projected into frame j, colours compared (15x15 local NCC, L1) on the same pixel set: tests the geometry + cameras without the texture; fused > depth map means the fused surface is more multi-view consistent than the per-frame depth

verts4d: static: verts4d repeats rest_verts in every frame

with_refined_cameras.note: same model evaluated with cams_refined.npz (frames registered to the backdrop)

gallbladder_bed.lower_bound: bed >= 90th percentile of the gallbladder front depth (reference view) + gb_gap
